name: MBPTL-001 Most Basic Penetration Testing Lab
description: A compact Linux penetration-testing lab with a public web bookstore, an administrator panel, local privilege escalation, internal Flask SSTI, and an internal binary exploitation service. Compromise the exposed application, pivot into the internal services, and collect every flag.
hint: Start with the two exposed HTTP services, then use the compromised main container as the pivot point to reach mbptl-app:5000 and mbptl-internal:31337.
